BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1.

Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is hereby amended by
changing all of the M1-1 Limited Manufacturing/Business Park District Symbols and indications as
shown on Map No. 24-B in the area bounded by

A line 793.33 feet North of and parallel to East 103rd Street;
The Chicago, Rock Island and Pacific Railroad Right-of-Way;
A line 491.00 feet North of and parallel to East 103" Street; And North Torrence Avenue.

To those of M2-1 Light Industry District.

SECTION 2.

This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due publication.

Common Address of Property: 10145 -10207 South Torrence Avenue.
